title: Peer shadow rotation log — week 1 (new hires)
summary: Working notes from the first-week peer-shadow rotation for two new platform engineers. Mix of observations, quick wins, access issues, interview follow-ups, and recommended changes to the technical onboarding checklist.
content:
Purpose: capture day-by-day impressions and concrete, small tweaks we can make to reduce ramp time. This is intentionally informal — notes taken during pairing and ad-hoc 1:1s.

Day 1 (Apr 13) — boot/cold-start
- New hires: Samir Rao (SWE II) and Priya Nair (SWE I) joined platform-engineering.
- Morning: basic access review — okta, GCP project viewers, Redwood dev Slack channels. Samir hit a permissions gap for the dedicated-cluster-reader role (ticket created JIRA-ENG-2143).
- Observations: internal onboarding doc links are a bit scattered; both asked where the minimal path-to-first-PR is.
- Quick wins: added a short README stub in the onboarding folder with exact sequence: git clone -> ./scripts/dev-setup -> attach to VPN -> run local smoke tests.

Day 2 (Apr 14) — shadowing runtime team pairing
- Pairing with Arjun on a live KV-cache bug: good to see end-to-end triage. Priya did the initial repro and wrote a small test case.
- Notes: our local dev stack took 45m to boot because of one stale docker image; suggested trimming optional components from docker-compose for day-1 flows.
- Mentorship: encouraged pairing on a small bug and shipping the fix — both responded well to that rapid feedback loop.

Day 3 (Apr 15) — interview debrief prep + hiring feedback session
- We ran a short mock debrief exercise to prepare the new hires for panel-style interview wrap-ups (useful since they will be involved as interviewers soon).
- Debrief takeaways for interview process (from Samir + Priya):
  * Interview rubric is good but ambiguous on "system design" depth for SWE I — recommend add clearer expected scope per level.
  * Pair exercise timelines felt tight (45m). Suggest optional 60m slot for remote pairing when network conditions are shaky.
  * Interviewer training: add a 30m shadowing session where new interviewers observe a live interview and see scoring examples.
- Action: draft to update hiring rubric (linked to JIRA-ENG-2198 — recruiter request).

Day 4 (Apr 16) — onboarding kafka stream exercise
- Hands-on walkthrough: end-to-end event path for telemetry ingestion.
- Observation: diagrams in Confluence were accurate but lacked command snippets for "how to run locally". Priya created a short cheatsheet that will be added to the page.
- Access problem: the telemetry-dev topic was missing from Samir's dev project; resolved by infra on-call (ticket resolved).

Day 5 (Apr 17) — retrospective + health check
- Quick health check 1:1s with both new hires:
  * Samir: generally confident, wants more ownership early; interested in tackling small infra features.
  * Priya: excited but a little overwhelmed by the breadth of infra tools; suggests a small recommended reading list for the first 2 weeks.
- Team health signals: time-to-first-green-PR measured for cohort is ~5 days (target: <=3). Bottlenecks: dev-env boot time, permissions friction, and unclear first-task granularity.

Concrete action items (short-term)
- A1: Create "first-PR recipe" doc (3–5 steps) and pin in onboarding folder. Owner: Maya (due Apr 20).
- A2: Trim dev docker compose to minimal components for day-1; provide optional script to bring up extras. Owner: Arjun (due Apr 22).
- A3: Add 30m interviewer shadow to the interview training checklist and clarify system design expectations per level. Owner: Leah (due Apr 24), linked JIRA-ENG-2198.
- A4: Add command snippets and local run cheatsheet to telemetry ingestion Confluence page. Owner: Priya (due Apr 19).
- A5: Improve access checklist: list of required IAM roles by folder (put at top of onboarding README). Owner: Diana (due Apr 18), linked JIRA-ENG-2143.

Blockers (still open)
- B1: One-off project permission (cluster-read) — blocker for faster debug loop (JIRA-ENG-2143).
- B2: Docker image cache in CI occasionally causes local boot to fail; need cleanup script.

Hiring-related notes
- Candidate pipeline: we have 3 upcoming onsite/backfills for runtime engineers (recruiter update next week). Priya and Samir will be invited to observe; we should schedule a 20m pre-brief for new hires so they understand evaluation expectations.
- Interview feedback meta: we saw inconsistent wording on feedback forms across interviewers — low-effort change: provide a template sentence bank to speed up and standardize notes.

Miscellaneous observations and quick wins implemented this week
- Added a single-file "day-0-to-PR.md" to the onboarding folder (temporary) and linked from welcome Slack DM.
- Shortened the dev env bootstrap by removing the optional 'analytics-mock' container from default compose; added --with-analytics flag.
- Ran a 30m skip-level sync with platform-op manager to clarify initial ownership boundaries for new hires.

Follow-ups for next week
- Verify A1–A5 progress in the Monday onboarding sync.
- Schedule a 45m interview shadow session for Apr 22 (Leah to run).
- Measure time-to-first-green-PR for next cohort and track change vs baseline.

Appendix: raw snippets and micro-notes
- "day-0-to-PR.md" contents (working): 1) fork, 2) run scripts/dev-setup.sh, 3) claim a starter issue labeled onboarding-starter, 4) open PR and request review from buddy.
- Slack notes: #eng-onboarding pinned messages updated with the new README link (see slack thread 2026-04-13).
- Recommended reading (2-week): infra glossary, KV cache primer (internal), short guide to Redwood deployment pipeline (internal).

Notes taken by: Maya Chen during peer shadow rotation sessions (Apr 13–17). This doc captures ephemeral decisions and suggested low-friction improvements — please move finalized items into Confluence / JIRA as appropriate.
